scope: first-call global 14-field wrapper entry and return and frozen initial input QNRAIN, both arms; no new forecast or native build
axes: j,i,k, 1-based native coordinates in CSV; raw core records are j,k,i
comparison: numeric unequal; signed zeros equal, nonfinite fail closed; record signed deltas and exact float32 words
domain: only independently reconstructed first-call core ownership; halo/unowned cells are missing, never zero
anchor_mapping: read all four actual native corners and weights from pinned cohort CSV; never treat GC labels as coordinate ordinals
derived_outputs: complete input and entry/return difference counts and cross-tabulation
per-cell input/entry/return NR and entry QV/QC/TH/TK sparse changed records with exact raw fields
per-anchor all four corners and 39 levels direct raw values with core and owner metadata
input and entry-change horizontal support masks plus complete receipt and input inventory
limitations: Input and wrapper entry use model-air number mixing ratio, not internal volumetric number.
Global 14-field stages contain no pressure or Exner field.
First wrapper difference is a sampled state, not proof of causal transport or source origin.
Full raw streams remain external; compact derivatives retain changed cell values and explicitly identify missing domain cells.
